proof_requests: Send clear photos of the console itself (front + back) and the label showing CUH model number/serial.
Send photos of every accessory laid out (controller(s), HDMI, power cable, USB, etc.) to confirm completeness.
Send photos of all 7 game discs (front and back).
Send a short video test: power on + HDMI display working + controller connected + one game booted.
Send a short stress test (a few minutes) to support the 'no overheating' claim.
Send a clear photo of the UK receipt and ensure the serial matches the console label.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not evidence. With only the box photo, the console model/version, completeness of accessories, number/condition of games, and functional status of ports/overheating cannot be verified remotely, so pricing would be guesswork.
